name: Shadowprey Village
summary: Along Sar'theris Strand, Darkspear fishermen and tauren keep Shadowprey Village alive as a Horde port on Desolace's rocky southern coast. Their work sustains trade across the barren region.

sections.title: A Haven on the Strand
sections.body:
On Desolace's southern shore, Shadowprey Village clings to cliffs where centaur clans and the wastes leave few safe harbors. Troll fishermen make up most of the settlement. Their catches feed the village and inland posts such as Ghost Walker Post.

Wooden piers reach into the rough sea. From them, anglers fish deep water and dive for shellfish among the wrecks scattered along Sar'theris Strand.

sections.title: Coastal Tribulations
sections.body:
A port on Desolace's frontier faces danger from land and sea. Marauding centaur and the demon-summoning Burning Blade threaten from inland. Rough shoals and hungry sea life challenge those who fish the coast.

Tauren allies help defend the village and keep trade routes open across Kalimdor. They include Taiga Wisemane and the keepers of the inn and wind rider roost.

faq.q: Why is Shadowprey Village important to the Horde?
faq.answer: Desolace is an inhospitable wasteland with few natural resources, and Shadowprey Village is the Horde's only coastal port there. Its fish and shellfish feed garrisons such as Ghost Walker Post. Its wind rider hub connects to Stonetalon, Thunder Bluff, and Feralas.

aliases: who is in charge of shadowprey
faq.answer: No single chieftain is recorded for Shadowprey Village. Troll fishermen form a loose community, while tauren residents such as Taiga Wisemane help guard it from the Burning Blade cultists stirring in Desolace.

faq.q: Why are there tauren running the services in a troll village?
faq.answer: Shadowprey began as a Darkspear fishing outpost, and its work as a regional supply hub drew support from the wider Horde. Tauren oversee shared services. They keep the inn, manage the stables, and direct the wind rider roost connecting the port to Mulgore and beyond.

faq.q: What threats are troubling the fishermen?
faq.answer: Fishermen face hostile centaur inland and the Burning Blade, whose demon-summoning cultists hold Thunder Axe Fortress. Rough waters and dangerous sea life threaten them along the coast as well.

angles.text: As a troll, you find a rare haven of Darkspear coastal culture at Shadowprey. Your people practice spearfishing, diving, and coastal survival there.
As a Horde traveler crossing Desolace, you find Shadowprey Village the only coastal rest stop, flight hub, and secure supply base south of the Kodo Graveyard.
